supersedes: Only a02 game-design selection criteria, not the a01 evidence or FAIL gate
reviewer_decision_verbatim: Your stop was correct, and the a01 grid stays on record unchanged.

The failure is mostly in the reviewer’s targets. The 1.5 to 3 fly-lengths-per-second band sits where the forward neurons fire sparsely, so walking comes in short pushes. The decoded 10 ms bout metric measures those pushes, not what a player sees: the point-0 recording visibly crosses the arena.
Game feel will be chosen by the owner playing, not by bot targets.
a01: 24 points, zero passes; TARGET_MISSED and acceptance FAIL stay unchanged. Point 0 median decoded bout 0.09 s but path 38.14 fly lengths and grid coverage 70.95%.
scope: Dev-only safety-gated presets A/B/C/D; production remains v2.7. Random walking current and C takeoff speed are disclosed game design. No biological claim.
resting_swat_protocol_change: Independent rounds avoid variable accumulated strike history and preserve a strict 200-opportunity denominator. Matched v2.7 control is run; both its rate and original 88% baseline are required. Censored rounds count as nonescape.
